findings.region: Uppermost canopy tuft, above and left of upper-right crown
findings.observation: The highest foliage cluster is surrounded by visible background and does not meet the neighboring foliage or a visible branch. It reads as a floating canopy island. The isolated wood plate supplies no visible connecting limb in this gap.
findings.correction_principle: Resolve the visible crown connection using source-appropriate branch or foliage continuity; do not rely on an imagined hidden support across exposed background.

findings.view: Variants 1-3, neutral, ripe and unripe; clearest in Variant 3
findings.region: Basal stem and low curved strokes
findings.observation: Several low curved vine strokes do not visibly join their nearby upright stems. Most clearly, Variant 3 has a separate arc below the right stem with background between them; Variant 1 also leaves the long central upright above the low left curve. These curves read as detached plant fragments rather than continuous basal growth. Model/source describe living crooked vine layouts, not debris.
findings.correction_principle: Make intended basal growth visibly continuous with its owning vine, or establish its source-supported independent role; preserve the same corrected geometry in both harvest tints.

limitations: Bounded static visual screening of the supplied current plates, not native/game validation or a guarantee of defect absence.
Fixed map views and declared cosmetic variants were assessed as such; no unsupported requirement for three creature facings was imposed.
Visible composited shapes were judged. Separate garbage and scrap fragments were allowed by their source descriptions.
Harvest tint geometry was compared in the supplied plates; runtime state selection, particles, occlusion and bindings were not exercised.
